messages:
alex_chen: Heads-up — planning an infra apply tied to release/2026-03-20. Targets: VPC routing tweaks, NAT scaling, IAM role for billing-service, and KMS key policy rotation. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow. Plan attached below.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: SUCCESS with warnings. terraform plan summary: +3 modules, ~12 resources to change, no force-destroy. plan id plan-rc-8472. Snippet: 
```
# terraform plan -out=plan-rc-8472
- aws_route.table[private]: replace
~ aws_kms_key.billing_key: update policy
+ aws_iam_role.billing_runner: create
```

samir: Request — pin AWS provider to 5.14.0 and CI Terraform to v1.6.9. We hit a breaking behavior in 5.15 around kms policy simulation last month.

maria_p: +1 on pinning. For rollout: staging canary first, then serial prod shards (one AZ/shard at a time). Recommend 10m hold after each shard to monitor.

infra-oncall: Suggest automated rollback triggers: >2% auth error rate OR p50 latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m. Also prepare `pre-rollout-backup.tfstate` to restore if needed. I'll publish a short runbook with exact commands.

alex_chen: Canary plan: staging -> prod-shard-a -> prod-shard-b -> prod-shard-c. I'll kick canary at 02:10 UTC. Need explicit approvals from infra leads before first prod shard. Please react :thumbsup: if you approve.

samir: :thumbsup: Done. I've updated provider pin in the branch: `required_providers { aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "= 5.14.0" } }`

deploy-bot: Running `terraform apply -auto-approve plan-rc-8472` on staging now. Will post status.

deploy-bot: Apply completed on staging (+6m). No drift detected. Smoke tests OK. Tagging release rc/2026-03-20-infra. Starting prod-shard-a in 10m.

ops-bot: monitoring: smoke-auth 0 errors, latency p95 180ms.

maria_p: Note — KMS policy change adds an account alias and a small condition. Policy diff attached and I've given approval in the PR.

alex_chen: Approvals recorded from samir and maria_p. Infra leads: @jk and @lina please review before shard-a; otherwise we'll proceed on timeout 15m.

jk: Reviewing now, looks good :eyes:

jk: :thumbsup: Proceed.

deploy-bot: Starting prod-shard-a apply. If any failure, will auto-fail to rollback and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: prod-shard-a apply finished. One transient IAM attach error retried and completed. No rollback.

infra-oncall: Marking rollout 1/3 complete. Waiting 10m hold.

deploy-bot: prod-shard-b apply started.

deploy-bot: prod-shard-b apply FAILED: exceeded attach retry threshold on aws_iam_role.billing_runner. Initiating rollback for prod-shard-b and pausing rollout.

alex_chen: Stopping further shards. Initiating rollback plan: 1) Abort current apply 2) Run `terraform apply -state=pre-rollout-backup.tfstate` to restore previous state 3) Open incident if rollback takes >10m.

infra-oncall: Running restore now.

deploy-bot: Rollback apply completed. State restored from pre-rollout-backup.tfstate. DNS and routing unaffected. Notifying infra-sre for postmortem.

jk: I'll file a short postmortem in #postmortems. Preliminary cause: provider API rate-limit + retry logic edge case.

maria_p: I'll revert the provider pin bump in the branch until we confirm retry mitigation and test a reduced parallelism strategy.

alex_chen: Thanks everyone — we'll reschedule a smaller window tomorrow morning with lower parallelism and improved retry/backoff. Closing this rollout thread.
